items.headline: U.S. Inflation Rebounds to 3.7% as Energy Costs Surge Ahead of Midterms
items.summary: The U.S. Consumer Price Index rose to 3.7% year-over-year in September, driven higher by sharp increases in gasoline and energy prices. This unexpected uptick complicates upcoming interest rate decisions for the Federal Reserve and intensifies public debate over living costs just weeks before the U.S. midterm elections.

items.headline: Researchers Use AI to Design 'Molecular Scissors' Targeting Alzheimer's and ALS Proteins
items.summary: Scientists at the University of Washington used artificial intelligence models to design custom synthetic enzymes that act as molecular scissors targeting toxic proteins associated with neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and ALS. Published in the journal Nature on October 14, 2026, the breakthrough demonstrates that AI-designed proteins can dismantle target disease proteins up to 100 million times faster than uncatalyzed reactions.

items.headline: Ann Li Stuns Top Seed Aryna Sabalenka in Major Wuhan Open Upset
items.summary: American tennis player Ann Li defeated top seed Aryna Sabalenka in three sets at the Wuhan Open after converting her tenth match point. The dramatic result coincided with second seed Jessica Pegula's loss to Jelena Ostapenko, eliminating the tournament's top two seeds on the same day.

items.headline: Original Choreographer Mandy Moore Joins 'La La Land' Broadway Musical Team
items.summary: Three-time Emmy winner Mandy Moore has joined the creative team for the upcoming stage musical adaptation of La La Land as its choreographer. Announced on October 14, 2026, Moore and costume designer Mary Zophres are returning from the original 2016 Oscar-winning film to collaborate with Tony-winning director Bartlett Sher.
